lines.en: I tap on Haruka's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Not much. Was wondering if you were busy today.
: Oh, you know me. Just wallowing in self-pity and scrolling through pictures of more attractive girls on Instagram.
: Life is dumb. Let's hang out.
: Works for me. Was actually just about to ask if you wanted to come over.
: Of course! As long as you promise that your [niece] won't attack me or say anything about my boobs.
: I will do my very best...
: So...is there anything you wanted to do tonight?
How should I spend my time with Haruka?
Kiss. Jk, I Mean Hug. (Raise Lust)
